payload.title: is_weighing_brief decides the ruling duty from the MODE: evidence_weighing first line alone, a line that pre-J3 method-panel and non-split arbiter envelopes already carry without ever asking for side_rulings, so their verdict-bearing answers are refused with side_rulings:absent.
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:841-850 (is_weighing_brief keys on the first line only; its docstring says a pre-J3 envelope carries no marker, true for the aggregation brief but not for the weighing brief method panels already received)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:951-952 (the marker is the first line of every weighing brief and no version or ruling-ask stamp travels with it)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judgment_bridge.py:272-278 (_weighs_sides derives the ruling duty from that marker; its docstring says pre-J3 envelopes carry another brief)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judgment_bridge.py:363-364 (a verdict-bearing answer without side_rulings is refused for any envelope that carries the marker)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:701-710 (_minted_arbiter_inputs counts live and dead requests, so the group is not minted again for the same inputs digest)
payload.rule_violated: An envelope owes only what its own brief asked for: a duty keyed on a prompt line two different briefs share is a gate that cannot tell them apart (compare the mint-first doctrine of the judge bridge, judgment_bridge.py:189-209).
payload.notes: On the base d9150f5846 render_evidence_weighing_prompt (judge_fanout.py:874-892) already began with the marker for every method-panel split and every non-split arbitrated group, and those briefs never asked for side_rulings. After J3 an answer with a verdict and no side_rulings to such an in-flight envelope is refused with judge_verdict.side_rulings:absent on every replay, the executor releases the claim, and the mint treats the group as already asked (live or dead request, same inputs digest), so it stays owed in the arbiter lane until its seats change. The PR body says envelopes minted before this change owe no rulings, which holds for the aggregation brief only. Reachable only when such envelopes are in flight at deploy; the live request ledger was not inspected. Close condition: The weighing brief carries a version stamp on the envelope (read by is_weighing_brief and _weighs_sides instead of the first line), so only envelopes that asked for side_rulings owe them; a test builds a pre-J3 weighing envelope (marker, no ruling ask), answers it with a verdict and no side_rulings and asserts it is accepted, while a J3 envelope given the same answer is still refused. Plan row: J3 (the F0.7 exit). Verified at head 3451f5c3fc of open pull request #2135; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
